changes.description: A queer social night ride through Phoenix's history, hosted by Robert Castan of Cycle for Change. About 14 flat miles from the 2018 rainbow crosswalk at Central and Portland: down Washington Street on the route of the first Pride march in 1981, through Encanto and Willo and up 3rd Avenue to the Melrose Curve (the one stop), the Grand Canal path from 7th Avenue to 12th Street, down through Coronado, and back on the old Fruit Loop bar circuit to coffee. No-drop, free.
